title: Percepciones sobre el uso de IA en el periodismo vasco y su integración en los medios

live_model.evidence: "se ha utilizado ChatGPT (GPT-4-turbo, marzo de 2025)...para mejorar la claridad del texto...utilizada para generar la Figura 14" (methodology note)

prompt.note: Writing/figure-generation assistance disclosure; the paper itself is a survey of Basque journalists' AI-tool usage, not an LLM benchmark.

claim.metric: none for GPT-4-turbo (the paper's numeric results, e.g. ChatGPT used weekly by 40.1% of surveyed journalists, describe human respondents' self-reported tool usage, not any LLM's task performance)

data.source: 504 survey interviews with Basque journalists (own survey instrument)

notes: A social-science survey of journalists' AI adoption; GPT-4-turbo is disclosed only as the authors' own manuscript-preparation aid. The paper's percentages are about how often human journalists report using tools like ChatGPT, not a model-performance claim.
